CustomField.formula:
IF( ISPICKVAL(Primary_Phone__c, 'Work Phone'), '(' & LEFT(OtherPhone, 3) & ') ' & MID(OtherPhone, 4, 3) & '-' & RIGHT(OtherPhone, 4),
IF( ISPICKVAL(Primary_Phone__c, 'Mobile Phone'), '(' & LEFT(MobilePhone, 3) & ') ' & MID(MobilePhone, 4, 3) & '-' & RIGHT(MobilePhone, 4),
IF( ISPICKVAL(Primary_Phone__c, 'Home Phone'), '(' & LEFT(HomePhone,3) & ') ' & MID(HomePhone, 4, 3) & '-' & RIGHT(HomePhone, 4), '' ) ) )
CustomField.label: Primary Phone Number
